Answer: B
Reason: The radiograph shows a curvilinear opacity (scimitar vein) descending along the right heart border toward the right costophrenic angle, accompanied by dextroposition of the heart and a small right hemithorax. This constellation of findings is classic for Scimitar syndrome, where right lung hypoplasia causes the mediastinum and heart to shift toward the affected side.
